subject: Renewal offer question
full_text:
Resident: Hi, got the renewal offer for March. We want to stay. Is 12 months the best rate or is there a longer option? Also does Biscuit stay on the same pet rent?
Office: Great to hear you're staying! 12 months is the best monthly rate this cycle. Pet rent doesn't change at renewal.

subject: AC not cooling
full_text:
Resident: AC is running but blowing warm air, thermostat says 78 and climbing. I work from home so mornings are best. My dog is Biscuit, he's friendly but barks, I'll crate him if you tell me when you're coming.
Tech note 6/9: capacitor bad on condenser, replaced. unit cooling, 72 at 10:40. res home, dog crated.
Tech note 6/9: filter was pretty dirty, told res to change it monthly

subject: AC out again
full_text:
Resident: AC stopped cooling AGAIN. Same as June. Its 84 inside. Please come in the morning if possible, Biscuit will be in his crate.
Tech note 8/19: drain line clogged and float switch tripped, cleared line w/ vac and reset. cooling now
Tech note 8/20: rechecked, temp split good. recommend HVAC vendor look at unit age

subject: Is the AC getting replaced?
full_text:
Resident: Hi, AC is working again but this is the second time this summer. Is someone going to look at replacing the unit?
Office: Sorry about that, Marisol. The tech flagged it for our HVAC vendor to evaluate. We'll call you once we have a date.
Resident: Ok please do. Mornings are best, and remind them about Biscuit.
Office: Noted on both. We'll follow up by the end of next week.

subject: Callback: HVAC vendor visit
full_text: Call summary: Called resident back about the HVAC vendor evaluation promised on 8/20 (a few days later than promised). Vendor visit set for 9/5, 9-11 AM. Resident confirmed Biscuit will be crated.

subject: HVAC vendor evaluation
full_text:
Office-entered request: HVAC vendor to evaluate the system after two no-cool calls this summer.
Tech note 9/5: vendor says compressor is original to the unit, recommends replacement before next summer. quote sent to mgr.

subject: Dog park gate
full_text:
Resident: Is the dog park gate getting fixed? Biscuit almost got out yesterday
Office: Thanks for flagging! Maintenance is on it today.
Resident: thank you!!

subject: AC rattling
full_text:
Resident: AC makes a loud rattling noise when it kicks on. Still cools. Is this the same unit that was supposed to be replaced? Mornings please.
Tech note 10/28: loose panel on air handler, tightened. noise better but not gone. replacement still pending per mgr

subject: Clubhouse reservation
full_text:
Resident: Can I reserve the clubhouse for Saturday the 17th, 6-10 PM?
Office: Yes, it's open! Please sign the reservation form in the portal.
Resident: Done. Same setup as last time if possible, the long tables.
Office: Got it, long tables it is.

subject: Slow kitchen drain
full_text:
Resident: Kitchen sink drains really slow and there's a smell. ok to enter anytime.
Tech note 3/3: snaked kitchen drain, ran water 5 min, draining fine

subject: Renewing - can rent stay close?
full_text:
Resident: I'd like to renew. Is there any way to keep the rent the same or close? I've been here 3 years.
Office: Thanks for staying with us, Theo! The 12-month offer in the portal is the best rate we can do this year. Happy to walk through it if that helps.
Resident: OK, I'll sign it.

subject: Clubhouse reservation
full_text:
Resident: Clubhouse again for game night, Oct 24, 6-10?
Office: You're all set for Oct 24. Long tables again?
Resident: yep, thanks

subject: Smoke detector chirping
full_text:
Resident: Smoke detector chirping in the bedroom. I work nights so please don't come before 11. And please don't call before 10, text is best.
Office: Got it. Work order entered for after 11 AM tomorrow.
Tech note 1/16: replaced battery in bedroom smoke det, tested ok. entered 11:30 per res request

subject: Bathroom fan loud
full_text:
Resident: bathroom fan really loud, rattles. after 11am pls, I sleep days
Tech note 4/8: fan motor worn, replaced. quiet now

subject: Renewal call (too early)
full_text: Call summary: Called resident at 9:10 AM about the renewal offer. Resident was asleep and reminded us they've asked not to be called before 10 AM. Apologized. Will text from now on.

subject: Renewal offer and 9-month question
full_text:
Office: Hi Jordan, your renewal offer for Dec 1 is in the portal: 12 months at $1,394 or 6 months at $1,449. Let us know if you have questions!
Resident: thanks. can I do 9 months? might move closer to work next fall
Office: Let me check with the manager and text you back.

subject: Still waiting on 9-month option
full_text:
Resident: hey still waiting to hear about the 9 month option. need to decide by nov 1 right?
Office: So sorry for the delay! The manager approved 9 months at $1,419. Want me to put it in the portal?
Resident: yes please

subject: Move-in day logistics
full_text:
Resident: Hi, we move in Sept 12. What time can we get keys, and do we reserve a spot for the moving truck?
Office: Keys are ready from 10 AM at the leasing office. You can reserve the two spots by the side entrance on the move-in form. Please upload proof of renters insurance before key pickup.

subject: Move-in items
full_text:
Resident: Moved in today. few things: bedroom 2 blind is broken, closet door off track, and freezer isn't cold yet (maybe it needs time?). Fine to enter, someone is home most days this week. Waffles (dog) is friendly.
Tech note 9/14: replaced blind, put closet door back on track. freezer at 4F now, working, just needed time

subject: Internet providers
full_text:
Resident: Which internet providers can we use here?
Office: Your building is wired for two providers. The info sheet is in the portal under Documents > Move-In.
Resident: found it, thanks

subject: Locker code not working
full_text:
Resident: We got a notice that a package is in the locker but the code doesn't work
Office: Sorry about that! I reset it. You'll get a new code by text in a few minutes.
Resident: Got it, worked

subject: No heat
full_text:
Resident: Heat not coming on. Thermostat set to 70, apartment is 61. Ok to enter.
Tech note 10/7: furnace ignitor bad, replaced. heating to 70

subject: Roommate swap in January
full_text:
Resident: One of our roommates is moving out in January and a friend wants to take their spot. How does that work?
Office: The new roommate applies online and, once approved, we do a lease change to swap names (there's a lease change fee). I'll send the link.

subject: Toilet keeps running
full_text:
Resident: Toilet keeps running after flush, have to jiggle the handle.
Tech note 12/4: replaced flapper and fill valve. ok

subject: Water heater popping
full_text:
Resident: Water heater making a popping noise and the water isn't very hot.
Tech note 2/12: flushed tank, lots of sediment. temp ok now. heater is old, recommend replacement in next yr or 2

subject: Longer lease option?
full_text:
Resident: My lease is up in February. Is there any way to do a longer lease, like 15 or 18 months, to lock in the rent?
Office: Great question! Renewal offers go out about 90 days before your lease ends, and longer terms are often available. I'll note your interest.
Resident: ok thanks

subject: Dishwasher not draining
full_text:
Resident: Dishwasher not draining, standing water at the bottom.
Tech note 8/6: food debris clogging filter and drain hose, cleared. ran cycle, drains ok

subject: Asking again: 15 or 18 months
full_text:
Resident: Asking again about a longer lease, 15 or 18 months. My lease ends Feb 28. I'd like to know before offers go out because we're deciding whether to buy a house.
Office: Thanks for following up. I'll ask the community manager what longer terms we'll offer and call you back this week.
Resident: Please do. After 5 PM is best.

subject: Callback: longer lease terms
full_text: Call summary: Returned resident's call about longer terms (asked 6/30 and again 10/10; callback was promised for the week of 10/10). Manager will include 15- and 18-month options in the renewal offer, going out early December. Resident is likely to stay if 18 months is close to the 12-month rate. Prefers calls after 5 PM.

subject: Package marked delivered, not here
full_text:
Resident: My package says delivered but it's not in the locker or at my door.
Office: I'm sorry! Our package room shows nothing for you today. Can you check the carrier's delivery photo?
Resident: Photo shows it at the wrong building
Office: Thanks. We'll check the building next door and let you know.

subject: Garbage disposal hums
full_text:
Resident: Garbage disposal hums but won't spin.
Tech note 1/19: disposal jammed, freed with allen key, hit reset. working

subject: Wrong building again
full_text:
Resident: Second time this happened, package went to the wrong building again. Can you put up a sign or something?
Office: That's frustrating, sorry. We've asked the carrier to update their building map and we're putting a new sign at the entrance.
Resident: thanks, hope it works

subject: Washer leaking
full_text:
Resident: Washer leaking from the bottom during spin, puddle on the floor.
Tech note 7/15: drain hose cracked, replaced. ran test cycle, no leak

subject: Wrong building, 3rd time
full_text:
Resident: package went to the wrong building AGAIN (3rd time). is the sign up?
Office: So sorry. The sign went up in April, but we'll raise it with the carrier again and walk your package over today.
Resident: ok ty

subject: Guest parking for visitors
full_text:
Resident: My parents are visiting for a week in April. Where can they park overnight?
Office: Guest spots are by the clubhouse. They'll need a guest pass from the office, good for up to 7 nights.

subject: Bathroom outlet dead
full_text:
Resident: Bathroom outlet stopped working. hairdryer tripped it maybe?
Tech note 5/12: reset GFCI in kitchen, bath outlet is on same circuit. working

subject: Why is my bill higher?
full_text:
Resident: Why is my bill $18 higher this month?
Office: That's the water/sewer charge. It's based on usage and usually goes up in summer. You can see the breakdown under Payments > Ledger.
Resident: ok makes sense

subject: Fob won't open gym
full_text:
Resident: Is the fitness center open 24 hrs? my fob didn't work at 5 am
Office: It's 24 hours, so your fob should work. I've reactivated it for the fitness center. Let us know if it happens again.
Resident: worked this morning, thanks

subject: Leak under kitchen sink
full_text:
Resident: Leak under the kitchen sink, cabinet floor is soaked.
Tech note 11/10: slip nut loose on p-trap, tightened and replaced washer. cabinet floor damp, left fan

subject: Kitchen sink leaking again
full_text:
Resident: kitchen sink leaking again, same spot as November.
Tech note 1/7: p-trap cracked, replaced whole trap assembly. no leak after 10 min.
Tech note 1/7: cabinet floor water damaged, needs replacing - entered sep WO

subject: Replace sink cabinet floor
full_text:
Office-entered request: replace water-damaged base cabinet floor under kitchen sink.
Tech note 2/10: cut out and replaced cabinet floor, sealed edges. res happy

subject: Stain on bathroom ceiling
full_text:
Resident: brown stain on the bathroom ceiling is getting bigger. Upstairs neighbor?
Tech note 4/23: wax ring failed on upstairs toilet, replaced (separate WO upstairs). ceiling here has to dry out before drywall repair, will come back

subject: When will the ceiling be fixed?
full_text: Call summary: Resident called asking when the bathroom ceiling will be repaired; it has been a month since the leak. Told resident the manager would call back by Friday with a date. Resident prefers calls weekdays 9 AM - 3 PM.

subject: Bathroom ceiling drywall repair
full_text:
Office-entered request: drywall repair, bathroom ceiling (water damage from upstairs leak).
Tech note 6/3: cut out stained drywall, replaced, taped and mudded. coming back to texture
Tech note 6/5: textured and painted. done

subject: Slow tub, gurgling sink
full_text:
Resident: Tub drain is slow and the kitchen sink gurgles. After everything with the plumbing this year I'm worried.
Office: Understood, we'll get someone out today. Same window, weekdays 9 to 3?
Resident: yes. And just so you know, nobody called me back in May about the ceiling.
Office: I'm sorry about that. I'll make sure the manager knows.

subject: Kitchen sink leaking - 4th time
full_text:
Resident: Kitchen sink leaking under the cabinet AGAIN. 4th time. Please send someone who can fix it for good.
Tech note 10/24: supply line fittings corroded, replaced both supply lines. plumbing vendor to camera the drain line next wk

subject: Second parking permit
full_text:
Resident: I'm getting a second car. How do I get another parking permit?
Office: Each apartment includes one permit; a second is $25/month. Fill out the vehicle form in the portal with the plate and we'll mail you the sticker.

subject: How is the permit billed?
full_text:
Resident: Do I need to do anything to pay the $25 permit or is it added to rent?
Office: It's added to your monthly charges automatically starting next month.

subject: Pool hours
full_text:
Resident: Pool hours this summer?
Office: 9 AM to 9 PM daily through Labor Day.
Resident: thx

subject: Referring a friend
full_text:
Resident: A friend referred me when I moved in. Can I refer someone now too?
Office: Yes! If they put your name on their application and move in, you'll get a credit on your account.

subject: Ceiling fan wobbles
full_text:
Resident: Bedroom ceiling fan wobbles a lot on high. OK to enter but my cat Pepper hides under the bed and will try to run out the front door, please keep it closed!
Tech note 1/28: balanced blades, tightened mount. kept door closed, cat under bed

subject: Renewing - pet rent?
full_text:
Resident: I want to renew. Is the pet rent going up too?
Office: Pet rent stays the same at renewal. Your offer is in the portal.
Resident: great, signed it. Pepper says thanks

subject: Fridge leaking
full_text:
Resident: Refrigerator is leaking water onto the floor. Please mind the door, Pepper is an escape artist
Tech note 5/5: defrost drain clogged, cleared and flushed. kept door shut, didn't see cat

subject: Pest control reminder
full_text:
Office: Reminder: quarterly pest control is tomorrow, 8 AM - 12 PM. Please secure pets.
Resident: ok. Pepper will be in the bathroom with the door shut, please don't open it

subject: Bathroom faucet dripping
full_text:
Resident: bathroom sink faucet dripping constantly. same cat rules as always, thanks!
Tech note 10/21: replaced cartridge, no drip

subject: Late fee question
full_text:
Resident: I got charged a late fee but I paid on the 3rd. Isn't there a grace period?
Office: The grace period ends on the 3rd at 11:59 PM. Your payment was made after the bank cutoff, so it posted on the 4th. Sorry for the confusion.
Resident: ok. can you waive it this once?
Office: I'll ask the manager and get back to you.

subject: Front door lock sticks
full_text:
Resident: front door lock sticks, hard to turn the key
Tech note 3/9: lubed lock, adjusted strike plate. turns smooth

subject: May balance - payment plan
full_text: Call summary: Resident called about the May balance. Hours were cut at work; can pay half now and half on the 20th. Manager approved a one-time payment plan. Late fee still applies per policy.

subject: Weak airflow
full_text:
Resident: AC airflow is weak, filter looks dusty
Tech note 7/15: replaced filter, cleaned return grille

subject: Another payment plan?
full_text:
Resident: I have $412.50 left from September. Can I set up another payment plan? I can pay $200 now and the rest on the 20th.
Office: I'll check with the manager and get back to you today. Have you thought about autopay? You can set it for a date that lines up with payday.
Resident: maybe. I get paid every other friday so the 1st doesn't always line up

subject: Renewal offer sent
full_text:
Office: Hi Devon, your renewal offer for Feb 1 is in the portal. Let us know if you have any questions.
Resident: Got it. Will my balance affect whether I can renew?

subject: El horno no calienta
full_text:
Resident: Hola, el horno no calienta. ¿Pueden venir mañana por la tarde?
Office: Hola Valeria, sí, mañana entre 1 y 5 PM. ¿Podemos entrar si no está en casa?
Resident: Sí, está bien.
Tech note 2/15: bake element burned out, replaced. oven heats to 350 ok

subject: Hormigas en la cocina
full_text:
Resident: Hay hormigas en la cocina, cerca del fregadero.
Tech note 5/1: treated kitchen and baseboards for ants. told res keep counters clear (texted in spanish)

subject: ¿Cuánto sube la renta?
full_text:
Resident: Hola, ¿cuánto sube la renta si renuevo por 12 meses?
Office: Hola Valeria. Su oferta de renovación está en el portal: $1,520 por 12 meses. ¿Quiere que se la explique por teléfono?
Resident: No, gracias, por texto está bien. La firmo hoy.

subject: Paquete en la oficina
full_text:
Office: Hola Valeria, tiene un paquete grande en la oficina.
Resident: Gracias, paso a las 6.

subject: Puerta del balcón trabada
full_text:
Resident: La puerta del balcón no cierra bien, se queda trabada.
Tech note 10/20: cleaned track, replaced slider rollers. opens/closes smooth. update texted to res in spanish

subject: Upstairs noise after midnight
full_text:
Resident: The upstairs neighbors are stomping and moving furniture after midnight most nights. I've knocked once. Can the office do something?
Office: Thanks for letting us know. We'll send a quiet-hours reminder to your building and contact the neighbor directly. Please keep a log of dates and times.

subject: Closet door off track
full_text:
Resident: Closet bifold door came off the track.
Tech note 2/21: reset door, replaced bottom pivot

subject: Noise log
full_text:
Resident: The upstairs noise is still happening. Log: 2/22, 2/25, 2/27, 3/1, all after 12:30 AM. I start work early.
Office: Thank you for the log. The manager has sent the neighbor a lease violation notice. If it continues, please call the after-hours line when it's happening so it's on record.

subject: Better now
full_text:
Resident: Just FYI it's been much better since March. Thanks.
Office: Glad to hear it! Let us know if anything changes.

subject: Top-floor transfer at renewal?
full_text:
Resident: My renewal is coming up in the spring. If the upstairs noise starts again, can I transfer to a top-floor unit when I renew?
Office: Transfers at renewal are possible depending on availability. Let's talk when your offer goes out in January.
Resident: ok. top floor is a must for me

subject: Annual inspection notice
full_text: Office: Hi Nadia, annual smoke detector and HVAC filter inspections are scheduled for March 10, 9 AM - 4 PM. No action needed unless you'd like to reschedule.

subject: Pool resurfacing notice
full_text: Office: Hi Nadia, pool resurfacing begins June 9 and will take about 2 weeks. Sorry for the inconvenience!

subject: Pest control notice
full_text: Office: Hi Nadia, quarterly pest control is Sept 22, 8 AM - 12 PM. Reply if you'd like us to skip your apartment.

subject: Roaches in kitchen
full_text:
Resident: seeing roaches in the kitchen at night, small ones. under the stove and in the cabinets
Tech note 12/16: gel bait in kitchen cabinets and behind stove. return in 2 wks

subject: Pest follow-up
full_text:
Office-entered request: pest control follow-up.
Tech note 1/5: still some activity, retreated. sealed gap behind stove where pipe comes thru wall

subject: Roaches back
full_text:
Resident: Roaches are back. Is this coming from next door? I keep my kitchen clean.
Office: We believe you. They often travel between apartments. We'll treat yours and the apartments on either side.
Resident: thank you, that's what I was hoping

subject: Bathroom fan not working
full_text:
Resident: bathroom exhaust fan doesn't work
Tech note 7/9: bad switch, replaced. fan running

subject: Roaches again
full_text:
Resident: few roaches again in the kitchen. not as bad as winter. pls treat the neighbors too like last time
Tech note 9/17: treated kitchen and bath. adjacent apartments treated per mgr

subject: Furnace blowing cold
full_text:
Resident: Furnace blowing cold air
Tech note 1/20: flame sensor dirty, cleaned. heating ok

subject: Dryer takes two cycles
full_text:
Resident: Dryer takes 2 cycles to dry clothes
Tech note 4/15: vent line packed w/ lint, cleaned to exterior. dries in one cycle

subject: Not renewing - job relocation
full_text:
Resident: I'm relocating for work and won't be renewing. My lease ends Nov 30. What do I need to do to give notice?
Office: Thanks for letting us know, and congratulations on the new job! Please submit your notice in the portal under Lease > Notice to Vacate. We'll send move-out instructions after that.

subject: Move-out checklist and deposit
full_text:
Resident: Submitted my notice. Can you send the move-out checklist?
Office: Done, it's in your email. Keys go back to the leasing office by noon on your move-out day.
Resident: and my deposit, how long does that take?
Office: The move-out statement and any refund go out within 30 days to the forwarding address you give us.

subject: Small repairs before move-out
full_text:
Resident: Want to fix a couple things before I move out. hole in the bedroom wall from a TV mount and a cracked outlet cover.
Tech note 10/20: patched drywall and painted. replaced outlet cover

subject: Pre-move-out walkthrough
full_text:
Resident: Can we do a pre-move-out walkthrough so I know if anything will be charged? Email is easiest to set a time.
Office: Yes! We can do Nov 20 or Nov 21 in the afternoon. Which works for you?

subject: Dishwasher leaves dishes gritty
full_text:
Resident: dishwasher leaving dishes dirty and gritty
Tech note 12/30: spray arm clogged, cleaned. cleaned filter, ran cycle ok

subject: Dishwasher leaking at door
full_text:
Resident: Dishwasher again, now leaking out the door.
Tech note 2/25: door gasket torn, replaced

subject: Dishwasher broken a third time
full_text:
Resident: Dishwasher is broken AGAIN, third time. Can we just get a new one?
Office: I'm sorry! Let me check the history and talk to the manager about replacing it.
Resident: thanks
Office: Update: the manager approved a new dishwasher. Installing Thursday.

subject: Renewing - carpet cleaning?
full_text:
Resident: We'll renew! Can we get the bedroom carpets cleaned as part of the renewal?
Office: Yes, one carpet cleaning comes with renewal. We'll schedule it after you sign.

subject: Furniture delivery before move-in
full_text:
Resident: I move in June 1. Can furniture be delivered to the office ahead of time?
Office: We can't accept furniture deliveries, but you can schedule them for June 1 any time after you pick up keys at 10 AM.

subject: After-hours lockout
full_text: Call summary: After-hours call at 11:40 PM. Resident locked out. On-call tech let resident in after checking ID. Explained the lockout fee in the lease.

subject: Spare key
full_text:
Resident: Can I get a spare key so I can leave one with a friend?
Office: Yes, spare keys are $25 and ready same day at the office.
Resident: cool, I'll grab one today

subject: Fob stopped working
full_text:
Resident: my fob doesn't open the gym or the pool gate anymore
Office: It looks like it was turned off during a system update. Reactivated now!
Resident: works, thanks

subject: Snow removal notice
full_text: Office: Hi Ezra, snow removal starts at 6 AM tomorrow. Please move your car to the north lot by 5 AM.

subject: Renewal offer sent
full_text: Office: Hi Ezra, your renewal offer is in the portal. Your current lease ends July 31.

subject: Water shut-off notice
full_text: Office: Hi Ezra, water will be shut off in your building Oct 15 from 9 AM to 1 PM for a repair. Sorry for the inconvenience.

subject: Change rent due date?
full_text:
Resident: Can I change my rent due date to the 5th? I get paid on the 4th.
Office: Rent is due on the 1st for everyone, but there's no late fee until after the 3rd. Some residents set autopay for the 3rd.
Resident: ok I'll do that

subject: Grill area
full_text:
Resident: is the grill area first come first serve?
Office: Yes! Just please clean the grill when you're done.

subject: Renewal offer - pushback
full_text:
Office: Hi Simone, your renewal offer is in the portal: $1,459 for 12 months (current rent $1,385).
Resident: That's a $74 increase, more than 5%. I've always paid on time. Is there any flexibility? I'm also looking at a few places nearby.

subject: Manager call about renewal
full_text: Call summary: Manager called resident about the renewal offer. Offered $1,435 for 12 months or $1,419 for 15 months. Resident will reply by 10/31. Resident asked that anything with numbers in it be sent by email.

subject: 15-month option in writing
full_text:
Resident: Thanks for the call. Can you put the 15-month option in writing? Leaning toward that.
Office: Of course. It's in the portal now, good through Nov 7.
